parameters.query:
=WITH profile AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(COALESCE('{{ ($json.user_profile.state_code || "ALL").toString().trim() }}','ALL')) AS state_code,
    LOWER(COALESCE('{{ ($json.user_profile.marital_status || "not_specified").toString().trim() }}','not_specified')) AS marital_status,
    LOWER(COALESCE('{{ ($json.user_profile.gender || "not_specified").toString().trim() }}','not_specified')) AS gender,
    LOWER(COALESCE('{{ ($json.user_profile.occupation || "not_specified").toString().trim() }}','not_specified')) AS occupation,
    {{ Number($json.user_profile.age || 0) }}::numeric AS age,
    {{ Number($json.user_profile.monthly_income || 0) }}::numeric AS monthly_income,
    {{ Number($json.user_profile.annual_income || (($json.user_profile.monthly_income || 0) * 12)) }}::numeric AS annual_income,
    {{ $json.user_profile.disability_status ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}::boolean AS disability_status,
    {{ Number($json.user_profile.disability_percentage || 0) }}::numeric AS disability_percentage
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    s.scheme_id,
    s.scheme_name,
    s.benefits,
    s.description,
    s.required_documents,
    s.pdf_template_key,
    COALESCE(s.state_code, 'ALL') AS scheme_state_code,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(s.state_code, 'ALL') = p.state_code THEN 20
        WHEN COALESCE(s.state_code, 'ALL') = 'ALL' THEN 16
        ELSE 0
      END
      + CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.pdf_template_key, '') <> '' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(pension|benefit|subsidy|assist|insurance|allowance|welfare|livelihood|employment|training|scheme)' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.annual_income > 0 AND p.annual_income <= 100000 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(bpl|income|assistance|support|pension|subsidy)' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.marital_status = 'widowed' AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) LIKE '%widow%' THEN 24 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.marital_status <> 'widowed' AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) LIKE '%widow%' THEN -8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.age >= 55 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(old age|pension|senior|elderly)' THEN 24 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.age >= 45 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(student|school|college|class 9|class 10|class 11|class 12|laptop|bicycle)' THEN -30 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN (p.occupation LIKE '%unemploy%' OR p.occupation = 'not_specified' OR p.occupation = 'none')
             AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(employment|skill|training|livelihood|job|self.?employment|allowance|assistance|pension)' THEN 18 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN (p.occupation LIKE '%unemploy%' OR p.occupation = 'not_specified' OR p.occupation = 'none')
             AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(student|school|college)' THEN -18 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.disability_status IS TRUE AND p.disability_percentage >= 40 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(disab|udid)' THEN 24 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.occupation LIKE '%farmer%' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(kisan|farmer|agri|crop)' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.gender = 'male' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(women|girl)' THEN -6 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.gender = 'female' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(women|girl)' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.gender = 'male' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(pregnan|maternity|mother|lactat|girl child|women beneficiaries)' THEN -40 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.age >= 45 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(pregnan|maternity|girl child|student|school|college)' THEN -20 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN p.age >= 55 AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, ''))) ~ '(old age|senior|elderly|pension|allowance)' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END
    )::numeric AS eligibility_score
  FROM schemes s
  CROSS JOIN profile p
  WHERE COALESCE(s.state_code, 'ALL') IN ('ALL', p.state_code)
    AND (LOWER(COALESCE(s.scheme_name, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(s.description, '')))
      ~ '(scheme|pension|benefit|subsidy|assist|insurance|health|education|housing|livelihood|employment|training|farmer|women|child|disab|welfare|allowance|support)'
), state_ranked AS (
  SELECT * FROM scored sc
  CROSS JOIN profile p
  WHERE p.state_code <> 'ALL'
    AND sc.scheme_state_code = p.state_code
), fallback_all_ranked AS (
  SELECT * FROM scored
  WHERE scheme_state_code = 'ALL'
)
SELECT scheme_id, scheme_name, benefits, description, required_documents, pdf_template_key, scheme_state_code, eligibility_score
FROM state_ranked
UNION ALL
SELECT scheme_id, scheme_name, benefits, description, required_documents, pdf_template_key, scheme_state_code, eligibility_score
FROM fallback_all_ranked
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM state_ranked)
ORDER BY eligibility_score DESC, scheme_id
LIMIT 8;

=INSERT INTO households (household_id_hash, profile_json, paralinguistic_json, consent_ledger_json)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.household_id_hash }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.user_profile).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ confidence: $('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.consent_ledger.confidence, tone: $('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.consent_ledger.tone, urgency: $('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.consent_ledger.urgency, original_language: $('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.original_language }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Translate Response (Sarvam)').first().json.consent_ledger).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (household_id_hash) DO UPDATE SET
  profile_json = EXCLUDED.profile_json,
  paralinguistic_json = EXCLUDED.paralinguistic_json,
  consent_ledger_json = EXCLUDED.consent_ledger_json;

VALUES (

  '{{ ($('Generate Response Text').first().json.eligible_schemes && $('Generate Response Text').first().json.eligible_schemes[0]) ? $('Generate Response Text').first().json.eligible_schemes[0].scheme_id : "general" }}',
  'pending_review',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Generate Response Text').first().json.user_profile || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ household_id_hash: $('Generate Response Text').first().json.household_id_hash, consent_recorded: $('Generate Response Text').first().json.consent_recorded, eligible_count: $('Generate Response Text').first().json.eligible_count, original_language: $('Generate Response Text').first().json.original_language }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $('Parse Profile + Hash').first().json.household_id_hash }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE SET
  applicant_data = EXCLUDED.applicant_data,
  form_data = EXCLUDED.form_data,
  household_hash = EXCLUDED.household_hash;

INSERT INTO profile_assessments (call_id, phone_number, user_profile, eligible_schemes, response_text)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Generate Response Text').first().json.call_id }}',
  '{{ $('Generate Response Text').first().json.phone_number }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Generate Response Text').first().json.user_profile || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Generate Response Text').first().json.eligible_schemes || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
